title: Contents Packout & Storage Odor Barrier Bag Charge for Smoke-Loss Contents
content:
Contents Packout & Storage contents from a smoke loss come back in odor barrier bags. On the pack-back box line of a return: **when the job's linked mitigation job is a company fire job with smoke severity heavy, each box brought back carries the heavy odor-bag charge; when that fire job's smoke severity is moderate, each box brought back carries the moderate odor-bag charge; when the smoke severity is light or odor only, the linked mitigation job is not a fire job, or there is none, no odor-bag charge applies.**

| Linked mitigation job | Smoke severity recorded on that Fire & Smoke Mitigation job | Charge per box brought back |
|---|---|---|
| a company fire job | heavy | 1.85 |
| a company fire job | moderate | 1.10 |
| a company fire job | light or odor only | none |
| not a fire job, or none | — | none |

The severity read is the smoke severity recorded on the Fire & Smoke Mitigation job that the contents job names as its linked mitigation job.

**Hypothetical illustration.** 50 boxes brought back on a job linked to a heavy-smoke fire job carry 50 times 1.85, or 92.50, in odor bags; linked to a moderate-smoke job, 55.00.
